questions.questionText: What is average time complexity of searching element in Hash Table?
questions.explanation: Hash table lookup operates in average constant O(1) time.

questions.questionText: Which data structure operates on Last In First Out (LIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: Stack adds and removes elements from same end (LIFO).

questions.questionText: Best algorithm for finding shortest paths from single source in non-negative weighted graph:
questions.explanation: Dijkstra solves single-source shortest path problem efficiently.

questions.questionText: Inorder traversal of Binary Search Tree (BST) produces nodes in:
questions.explanation: Inorder traversal (Left, Root, Right) of BST yields sorted values.

questions.questionText: Space complexity of iterative Binary Search algorithm on sorted array:
questions.explanation: Iterative binary search uses constant O(1) auxiliary memory.
